title: Good Day Sunshine | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning five-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach is the ultimate destination for families and large groups. With 2,900 square feet of impeccably designed living space, this recently renovated home comfortably sleeps up to 16 guests. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated, from Pottery Barn and West Elm furnishings to brand-new Helix mattresses and Smart TVs in every bedroom. The main level features an open-concept layout with a fully stocked kitchen, dining space for ten, a family room, and a spacious master suite. Outside, a charming front deck invites you to enjoy your morning coffee or gather for evening conversations. At the rear, a garage is stocked with complimentary bikes, beach chairs, umbrellas, and toys—everything you need for a perfect day on the coast. Set in the resort community of Seacrest Beach, this home is perfectly positioned for easy access to the 12,000-square-foot pool, pristine private beach, and the charming neighboring towns of Rosemary and Alys Beach. Take a leisurely stroll or hop on the complimentary tram to explore the area’s vibrant dining, shopping, and outdoor activities. From the scenic Timpoochee Trail to nearby state parks and coastal dune lakes, adventure awaits at every turn. After a day of exploring 30A’s emerald waters and white-sand beaches, return to the comfort of this luxurious coastal getaway, where every moment is designed to inspire relaxation and connection.
